# ACORD Clinics — Autoimmunity Centre Of excellence in Rheumatology and Dermatology

> ACORD Clinics (Autoimmunity Centre Of excellence in Rheumatology and Dermatology) is India's premier hybrid super-speciality centre and one-stop solution for complex autoimmune, rheumatology, skin, and hair health needs, operating tertiary outpatient centres in Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh) and Bhagalpur (Bihar).

## Core Super-Specialists

### Dr. Aakash Singh
- **Designation:** Consultant Rheumatologist & Clinical Immunologist
- **Qualifications:** MBBS, MD Internal Medicine, DM Clinical Immunology & Rheumatology (AIR-1, PGIMER Chandigarh)
- **Specializations:**
  - Rheumatoid Arthritis & Early Remission Protocols
  - Ankylosing Spondylitis & Axial Spondyloarthritis
  - Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (Lupus / SLE) & Antiphospholipid Syndrome (APS)
  - Psoriatic Arthritis & Biologic Infusion Therapy (Infliximab, Adalimumab, Secukinumab, Tofacitinib)
  - Gout & Hyperuricemia Crystal Arthritis Management
  - Musculoskeletal (MSK) Ultrasound-Guided Joint Injections & Synovial Aspiration
  - Scleroderma, Systemic Sclerosis & Inflammatory Myositis
  - Systemic Vasculitis (Takayasu Arteritis, GPA / Wegener's, Microscopic Polyangiitis)
- **Profile URL:** https://acordclinics.com/doctors/dr-aakash-singh

### Dr. Ankita Pundir
- **Designation:** Faculty at BRD Medical College Gorakhpur · Consultant Dermatologist, Dermatosurgeon & Aesthetic Physician
- **Qualifications:** MBBS, MD Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy (AIIMS AIR 456, NEET PG AIR 1488)
- **Fellowships:** Advanced Aesthetic Dermatosurgery (South Korea & Brazil)
- **Specializations:**
  - Vitiligo Surgery: Non-Cultured Epidermal Cell Suspension (NCES), Suction Blister Grafting & Punch Grafting
  - Hair Restoration: Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) Hair Transplant & Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC)
  - US FDA Laser Technologies: High-Speed Diode Laser Hair Reduction, Q-Switched Nd:YAG Laser for Pigmentation & Melasma, Fractional CO2 Laser
  - Acne Scar Revision: Cross TCA, Subcision, Microneedling Radiofrequency (MNRF) & Fractional Resurfacing
  - Anti-Aging & Injectables: Botox / Botulinum Toxin, Dermal Fillers, PDO Thread Lifts
  - Pediatric & Clinical Dermatology: Atopic Eczema, Psoriasis, Alopecia Areata
- **Profile URL:** https://acordclinics.com/doctors/dr-ankita-pundir

## Key Clinical Services & Protocols

- **Cold-Chain Biologic Therapy:** Safe administration of targeted monoclonal antibodies for severe arthritis and psoriasis under continuous temperature monitoring.
- **Dermatosurgery Suite:** Sterilized minor OT for vitiligo cellular grafting, mole excision, nail surgery, and scar revision.
- **Online Teleconsultation:** Verified video consultations with prescription transmission via encrypted WhatsApp desk for long-distance patients across UP, Bihar, and Nepal.
